meta.name: before-you-build
meta.description: Pre-build product and feature risk review for founders, product managers, and AI-assisted builders. Use this skill when the user is about to build a landing page, MVP, SaaS product, internal tool, agent workflow, or major feature and needs to check demand, positioning, monetization, retention, trust, distribution, and adoption risk before implementation starts.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你：是创始人或产品经理，想在投入开发前确认想法是否靠谱。
copy.tagline_en: Check product risks before you build
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're a founder or PM validating a product idea before development.

howto.what: 当你准备开发产品、功能或落地页时,Claude 会先做一次上线前风险检查:给出风险等级、最可能失败的假设、该先找的证据、下一步动作和暂时别做的部分。
howto.when: 当你要求新建或上线产品、MVP、落地页等,或做影响不明确的大功能时接管;纯实现修复、重构等已明确验证的改动会跳过。

say.text: 我打算做个内部工具,先帮我评估风险再动手
say.note: 输出风险等级、最大假设、下一步验证

say.text: 这个 MVP 的需求和变现你有把握吗?先别写代码
say.note: 先给证据清单,再缩减构建范围

say.text: 这个功能值不值得做?帮我看看留存和采用风险
say.note: 列出该暂缓构建的部分

howto.what_en: When you're about to build a product, feature, or landing page, Claude first runs a short pre-mortem: risk verdict, the assumption most likely to break, evidence to find first, next step, and what to delay.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to build or ship a product, MVP, or landing page, or a major feature with unclear impact. Skips narrow implementation fixes, refactors, and already-validated changes.

say_en.text: I want to build an internal tool — assess the risks first
say_en.note: Returns verdict, main assumption, next step

say_en.text: Is there real demand and a payment path for this MVP? Hold off coding
say_en.note: Gives evidence to find and a smaller scope

say_en.text: Should this feature ship? Check retention and adoption risk
say_en.note: Names what not to build yet
